title: 第二十五章 你是我第一个想娶的女人第二十六章 王跃你是个汉子
content_zh:
最新网址：阮莞生日过后的有十几天，王跃收到了金陵穿过来的邮件，王跃把邮件打印出来放在了桌边。又看了看外面工作忙碌的阮莞，在想什么时候，什么场合交给她。
这天很晚的时候，王跃接到一个邮件，他仔细的看完后，抬头看了看窗外办公区，阮莞又是在加班，到现在就剩下她最后一个了。
王跃把手里的工作结束，就抽出那份准备已久的文件，只不过比当初的文件厚实许多。
“莞莞，走吧，我哪里昨晚上又补货了，有新鲜的牛排，我请你吃夜宵！”王跃走到阮莞的桌前，敲了敲桌面。
“好啊！你等会哈！”阮莞看了一眼站在哪里，略显疲惫的王跃，便没有拒绝，柔柔的说。
“好的，有啥需要我帮忙的吗？”王跃随口问道。
“不用，这就好。”
一杯咖啡的时间，阮莞关了电脑，叫了王跃一起出了门。
两人锁了大门，就回到了家里，进了门，王跃刚准备去忙，阮莞却让王跃去休息，自己来。
不过，王跃没有坐下享受，而是帮忙打下手。还好是开放性厨房，不然两个人还真站不下。
王跃一边忙碌，一边看着阮莞。偶尔阮莞仿佛察觉到了他的目光，也会回眸笑一下，总惹得王跃呆愣，气氛有几分暧昧，像极了新婚小夫妻。两人不知不觉的，就做好了一份简单的夜宵。
佳肴摆上桌面后，王跃去酒柜拿了一瓶红酒冲阮莞示意一下，看她点头后，才把酒打开了，这份尊重让阮莞很受用。
两人坐在一起，倒上红酒，碰了碰杯后，阮莞抿了一口酒，突然开口，“说吧，我感觉你有什么重要的事情要对我说！”
王跃这边酒刚到嘴里，还没有咽下去，就差点喷了。
“你真是个聪慧的女子啊，我还是养气功夫不到家。”王跃叹气！
“你最近一段总是偷偷看我，他们早就发现了。不然，你以为他们为啥最近总是先走？”阮莞笑了笑。
“好吧，他们是不是在打赌，赌我那天会找你？”王跃自嘲的笑了，自己离肖奈大神，还远的很。
“是啊，其实我也很好奇！”阮莞偷笑。
“好吧，我承认我是挺喜欢你，你是那种接触多了，就让人想回家的女人，不过今天，却不是这事个情。”王跃的脸皮已经有一定的厚度，小腹黑的他还是趁机表达了心意。
“是吗？我挺感谢你对我的喜欢，不过……”阮莞听到王跃的肯定，心里甜甜的，不过，理智的她还是准备拒绝。

“你先看这个，本来想让你吃完夜宵再说的！”王跃看她想拒绝，赶紧打断了她的话。
“这是什么？”阮莞脸色红扑扑的，不知道是酒的原因，还是其他。
“你自己看吧。”王跃不想伤她心的话，是自己起头的。
“好！”阮莞已经打开了文件夹。
文件是按是日期的照片，照片上有具体的时间。
不知道多久，阮莞已经泪流满面，用带着浓浓鼻音的话，“你是什么时候调察的！”
“其实这是个巧合，还记得我去金陵吗？”王跃看着这个女孩坚强的样子，心里也不太好受。
“记得啊，王老板独战群富婆嘛！”阮莞想起这个事，心情瞬间好了点。
“那天我见到过赵世永和一个女孩一起甜蜜的去咖啡店！”王跃头疼这个梗了，不知道啥时候结束。
“你那时候应该不认识他吧！”阮莞疑惑？
content_en:
Latest website: A dozen days after Ruan Guan's birthday, Wang Yue received an email from Jin Lingchuan. Wang Yue printed out the email and put it on the table. Then he looked at Ruan Guan who was busy working outside, wondering when and when to hand it over to her.
Very late that day, Wang Yue received an email. After reading it carefully, he looked up at the office area outside the window. Ruan Guan was working overtime again, and now she was the last one left.
Wang Yue finished his work and took out the document that he had prepared for a long time. It was just much thicker than the original document.
"Wan Wan, let's go. I restocked last night. There are fresh steaks. I'll treat you to a supper!" Wang Yue walked to Ruan Wan's table and knocked on the table.
"Okay! Just wait a minute!" Ruan Guan glanced at Wang Yue, who was standing there, looking slightly tired, and said softly without refusing.
"Okay, how can I help you?" Wang Yue asked casually.
"No, that's fine."
During a cup of coffee, Ruan Guan turned off the computer and asked Wang Yue to go out together.
The two locked the door and returned home. After entering, Wang Yue was about to go to work, but Ruan Guan asked Wang Yue to rest and do it himself.
However, Wang Yue did not sit back and enjoy, but helped. Fortunately, it is an open kitchen, otherwise the two of us would not be able to stand.
While Wang Yue was busy, he looked at Ruan Wan. Occasionally, Ruan Wan seemed to notice his gaze and would look back and smile, which always made Wang Yue stunned. The atmosphere was a bit ambiguous, like a newlywed couple. The two of them unknowingly prepared a simple midnight snack.
After the delicacies were placed on the table, Wang Yue went to the wine cabinet and took a bottle of red wine to signal to Ruan Guan. After seeing her nod, he opened the wine. This respect was very useful to Ruan Guan.
The two sat together, poured red wine, and after clinking glasses, Ruan Guan took a sip of wine and suddenly said, "Tell me, I feel you have something important to say to me!"
As soon as Wang Yue's wine reached his mouth, he almost spit it out before he could swallow it.
"You are such a smart woman, but I still don't know how to nourish my energy." Wang Yue sighed!
"You have been secretly looking at me recently, and they have noticed it a long time ago. Otherwise, why do you think they always leave first recently?" Ruan Guan smiled.
"Okay, are they making a bet that I will look for you that day?" Wang Yue laughed to himself. He was still far away from the great master Xiao Nai.
"Yeah, actually I'm curious too!" Ruan Guan snickered.
"Okay, I admit that I quite like you. You are the kind of woman who makes people want to go home after being in contact with her too much. But today, that's not the case." Wang Yue's face already had a certain thickness, and he still took the opportunity to express his feelings despite his dark belly.
"Really? I'm very grateful for your liking for me, but..." Ruan Guan felt sweet in her heart when she heard Wang Yue's affirmation, but rationally, she was still ready to refuse.
"Look at this first. I wanted you to finish your late night snack before we talk!" Wang Yue saw that she wanted to refuse and quickly interrupted her.
"What is this?" Ruan Guan's face turned red. He didn't know if it was because of the wine or something else.
"See for yourself." If Wang Yue didn't want to hurt her, he would have started it himself.
"Okay!" Ruan Wan has already opened the folder.
The file is a dated photo with a specific time on the photo.
I don’t know how long it took, but Ruan Guan had tears streaming down his face and said in a thick nasal voice, “When did you investigate!”
"Actually, this is a coincidence. Do you remember when I went to Jinling?" Wang Yue felt uncomfortable looking at the girl's strong appearance.
"Remember, Boss Wang fought against a group of rich women alone!" Ruan Guan thought of this and felt better instantly.
"I saw Zhao Shiyong going to a coffee shop with a girl that day!" Wang Yue had a headache with this joke and didn't know when it would end.
"You probably didn't know him at that time!" Ruan Guan was confused?
